method: Independent 24pt Arial controls generated before changing the shared line breaker; an additional 16pt edge-control page was authored directly in OOXML independently of renderer output. Both opened without repair and were exported to local PDF. Text line boundaries read from native PDF; no PDF, image or reference-application font data is a renderer input.
compatibilityDecision: Native gives an explicit break opportunity after ASCII hyphens, including before a number, comma or U+2060. Consecutive ASCII hyphens stay on the previous line. This differs from default UAX14 rules. U+2010 and U+2011 do not receive the same native opportunity. Preserve their authored codepoints. U+2010 used native CambriaMath glyph fallback; this observation does not establish exact glyph fidelity for that fallback.
remaining: The seventh corpus deck's separate borderline Raleway text-box wrap differs. Font advances and native line fitting still require isolation; this fix does not claim complete text fidelity. Source SVG/native raster antialiasing remains distinct.
